en: (1) Ṭā, Seen, Meem.[1043]
enNotes: [1043]- See footnote to 2:1.

en: (2) These are the verses of the clear Book.

ar: لَعَلَّكَ بَٰخِعٌ نَّفْسَكَ أَلَّا يَكُونُوا۟ مُؤْمِنِينَ
en: (3) Perhaps, [O Muḥammad], you would kill yourself with grief that they will not be believers.
tr: Laʿallaka bākhiʿun nafsaka allā yakūnū muʾminīn

ar: إِن نَّشَأْ نُنَزِّلْ عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ ءَايَةً فَظَلَّتْ أَعْنَٰقُهُمْ لَهَا خَٰضِعِينَ
en: (4) If We willed, We could send down to them from the sky a sign for which their necks would remain humbled.[1044]
enNotes: [1044]- i.e., they would be compelled to believe.
tr: In nashaʾ nunazzil ʿalayhim minas-samāʾi āyatan faẓallat aʿnāquhum lahā khāḍiʿīn

ar: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن ذِكْرٍ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ مُحْدَثٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضِينَ
en: (5) And no mention [i.e., revelation] comes to them anew from the Most Merciful except that they turn away from it.
tr: Wamā yaʾtīhim min dhikrim minar-raḥmāni muḥdathin illā kānū ʿanhu muʿriḍīn

ar: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوا۟ فَسَيَأْتِيهِمْ أَنۢبَٰٓؤُا۟ مَا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
en: (6) For they have already denied, but there will come to them the news of that which they used to ridicule.
tr: Faqad kadhdhabū fasayaʾtīhim ambāʾu mā kānū bihī yastahziʾūn

ar: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ كَمْ أَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍ كَرِيمٍ
en: (7) Did they not look at the earth - how much We have produced therein from every noble kind?
tr: Awalam yaraw ilal-arḍi kam ambatnā fīhā min kulli zawjin karīm

ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
en: (8) Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
tr: Inna fī dhālika laʾāyah, wamā kāna aktharuhum muʾminīn

en: (9) And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

ar: وَإِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبُّكَ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱئْتِ ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
en: (10) And [mention] when your Lord called Moses, [saying], "Go to the wrongdoing people -
(11) The people of Pharaoh. Will they not fear Allāh?"

ar: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ أَن يُكَذِّبُونِ
en: (12) He said, "My Lord, indeed I fear that they will deny me
tr: Qāla rabbi innī akhāfu ay yukadhdhibūn

ar: وَيَضِيقُ صَدْرِى وَلَا يَنطَلِقُ لِسَانِى فَأَرْسِلْ إِلَىٰ هَٰرُونَ
en: (13) And that my breast will tighten and my tongue will not be fluent, so send for Aaron.
tr: Wayaḍīqu ṣadrī walā yanṭaliqu lisānī faʾarsil ilā hārūn

ar: وَلَهُمْ عَلَىَّ ذَنۢبٌ فَأَخَافُ أَن يَقْتُلُونِ
en: (14) And they have upon me a [claim due to] sin, so I fear that they will kill me."
tr: Walahum ʿalayya dhambum faʾakhāfu ay yaqtulūn

ar: قَالَ كَلَّا فَٱذْهَبَا بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ إِنَّا مَعَكُم مُّسْتَمِعُونَ
en: (15) [Allāh] said, "No. Go both of you with Our signs; indeed, We are with you, listening.
tr: Qāla kallā, fadhhabā biʾāyātinā innā maʿakum mustamiʿūn

ar: فَأْتِيَا فِرْعَوْنَ فَقُولَآ إِنَّا رَسُولُ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
en: (16) Go to Pharaoh and say, 'We are the messengers[1045] of the Lord of the worlds,
enNotes: [1045]- The singular form in Arabic indicates that both were sent with a single message.
tr: Faʾtiyā firʿawna faqūlā innā rasūlu rabbil-ʿālamīn

en: (17) [Commanded to say], "Send with us the Children of Israel."'"

ar: قَالَ أَلَمْ نُرَبِّكَ فِينَا وَلِيدًا وَلَبِثْتَ فِينَا مِنْ عُمُرِكَ سِنِينَ
en: (18) [Pharaoh] said, "Did we not raise you among us as a child, and you remained among us for years of your life?
tr: Qāla alam nurabbika fīnā walīdaw walabithta fīnā min ʿumurika sinīn

ar: وَفَعَلْتَ فَعْلَتَكَ ٱلَّتِى فَعَلْتَ وَأَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
en: (19) And [then] you did your deed which you did,[1046] and you were of the ungrateful."
enNotes: [1046]- i.e., striking the Copt, who died as a result.

ar: قَالَ فَعَلْتُهَآ إِذًا وَأَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
en: (20) [Moses] said, "I did it, then, while I was of those astray [i.e., ignorant].

ar: فَفَرَرْتُ مِنكُمْ لَمَّا خِفْتُكُمْ فَوَهَبَ لِى رَبِّى حُكْمًا وَجَعَلَنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
en: (21) So I fled from you when I feared you. Then my Lord granted me judgement [i.e., wisdom and prophethood] and appointed me [as one] of the messengers.
tr: Fafarartu minkum lammā khiftukum fawahaba lī rabbī ḥukmaw wajaʿalanī minal-mursalīn

ar: وَتِلْكَ نِعْمَةٌ تَمُنُّهَا عَلَىَّ أَنْ عَبَّدتَّ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
en: (22) And is this a favor of which you remind me - that you have enslaved the Children of Israel?"
tr: Watilka niʿmatun tamunnuhā ʿalayya an ʿabbatta banī isrāʾīl

en: (23) Said Pharaoh, "And what is the Lord of the worlds?"

ar: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
en: (24) [Moses] said, "The Lord of the heavens and earth and that between them, if you should be convinced."
tr: Qāla rabbus-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā, in kuntum mūqinīn

en: (25) [Pharaoh] said to those around him, "Do you not hear?"
(26) [Moses] said, "Your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers."

ar: قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَكُمُ ٱلَّذِىٓ أُرْسِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ لَمَجْنُونٌ
en: (27) [Pharaoh] said,[1047] "Indeed, your 'messenger' who has been sent to you is mad."
enNotes: [1047]- Angrily addressing those present.
tr: Qāla inna rasūlakumul-ladhī ursila ilaykum lamajnūn

ar: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقِ وَٱلْمَغْرِبِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
en: (28) [Moses] said, "Lord of the east and the west and that between them, if you were to reason."
tr: Qāla rabbul-mashriqi wal-maghribi wamā baynahumā, in kuntum taʿqilūn

ar: قَالَ لَئِنِ ٱتَّخَذْتَ إِلَٰهًا غَيْرِى لَأَجْعَلَنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمَسْجُونِينَ
en: (29) [Pharaoh] said, "If you take a god other than me, I will surely place you among those imprisoned."
tr: Qāla laʾinittakhadhta ilāhan ghayrī laʾajʿalannaka minal-masjūnīn

en: (30) [Moses] said, "Even if I brought you something [i.e., proof] manifest?"

ar: قَالَ فَأْتِ بِهِۦٓ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
en: (31) [Pharaoh] said, "Then bring it, if you should be of the truthful."
tr: Qāla faʾti bihī in kunta minaṣ-ṣādiqīn

ar: فَأَلْقَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِىَ ثُعْبَانٌ مُّبِينٌ
en: (32) So [Moses] threw his staff, and suddenly it was a serpent manifest.[1048]
enNotes: [1048]- i.e., clearly genuine.
tr: Faʾalqā ʿaṣāhu faʾidhā hiya thuʿbānum mubīn

ar: وَنَزَعَ يَدَهُۥ فَإِذَا هِىَ بَيْضَآءُ لِلنَّٰظِرِينَ
en: (33) And he drew out his hand; thereupon it was white for the observers.
tr: Wanazaʿa yadahū faʾidhā hiya bayḍāʾu lin-nāẓirīn

ar: قَالَ لِلْمَلَإِ حَوْلَهُۥٓ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَسَٰحِرٌ عَلِيمٌ
en: (34) [Pharaoh] said to the eminent ones around him, "Indeed, this is a learned magician.
tr: Qāla lil-malaʾi ḥawlahū inna hādhā lasāḥirun ʿalīm

ar: يُرِيدُ أَن يُخْرِجَكُم مِّنْ أَرْضِكُم بِسِحْرِهِۦ فَمَاذَا تَأْمُرُونَ
en: (35) He wants to drive you out of your land by his magic, so what do you advise?"
tr: Yurīdu ay yukhrijakum min arḍikum bisiḥrih, famādhā taʾmurūn

ar: قَالُوٓا۟ أَرْجِهْ وَأَخَاهُ وَٱبْعَثْ فِى ٱلْمَدَآئِنِ حَٰشِرِينَ
en: (36) They said, "Postpone [the matter of] him and his brother and send among the cities gatherers
tr: Qālū arjih waʾakhāhu wabʿath fil-madāʾini ḥāshirīn

en: (37) Who will bring you every learned, skilled magician."
(38) So the magicians were assembled for the appointment of a well-known day.[1049]
enNotes: [1049]- i.e., the morning of the day of festival. See 20:58-59.

en: (39) And it was said to the people, "Will you congregate

ar: لَعَلَّنَا نَتَّبِعُ ٱلسَّحَرَةَ إِن كَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْغَٰلِبِينَ
en: (40) That we might follow the magicians if they are the predominant?"

ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ قَالُوا۟ لِفِرْعَوْنَ أَئِنَّ لَنَا لَأَجْرًا إِن كُنَّا نَحْنُ ٱلْغَٰلِبِينَ
en: (41) And when the magicians arrived, they said to Pharaoh, "Is there indeed for us a reward if we are the predominant?"
tr: Falammā jāʾas-saḥaratu qālū lifirʿawna aʾinna lanā laʾajran in kunnā naḥnul-ghālibīn

ar: قَالَ نَعَمْ وَإِنَّكُمْ إِذًا لَّمِنَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبِينَ
en: (42) He said, "Yes, and indeed, you will then be of those near [to me]."

ar: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰٓ أَلْقُوا۟ مَآ أَنتُم مُّلْقُونَ
en: (43) Moses said to them, "Throw whatever you will throw."
tr: Qāla lahum mūsā alqū mā antum mulqūn

ar: فَأَلْقَوْا۟ حِبَالَهُمْ وَعِصِيَّهُمْ وَقَالُوا۟ بِعِزَّةِ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلْغَٰلِبُونَ
en: (44) So they threw their ropes and their staffs and said, "By the might of Pharaoh, indeed it is we who are predominant."
tr: Faʾalqaw ḥibālahum waʿiṣiyyahum waqālū biʿizzati firʿawna innā lanaḥnul-ghālibūn

ar: فَأَلْقَىٰ مُوسَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِىَ تَلْقَفُ مَا يَأْفِكُونَ
en: (45) Then Moses threw his staff, and at once it devoured what they falsified.
tr: Faʾalqā mūsā ʿaṣāhu faʾidhā hiya talqafu mā yaʾfikūn

en: (46) So the magicians fell down in prostration [to Allāh].
(47) They said, "We have believed in the Lord of the worlds,
(48) The Lord of Moses and Aaron."

ar: قَالَ ءَامَنتُمْ لَهُۥ قَبْلَ أَنْ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمْ إِنَّهُۥ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلسِّحْرَ فَلَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ لَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُم مِّنْ خِلَٰفٍ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
en: (49) [Pharaoh] said, "You believed him [i.e., Moses] before I gave you permission. Indeed, he is your leader who has taught you magic, but you are going to know. I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will surely crucify you all."
tr: Qāla āmantum lahū qabla an ādhana lakum, innahū lakabīrukumul-ladhī ʿallamakumus-siḥr, falasawfa taʿlamūn, laʾuqaṭṭiʿanna aydiyakum waʾarjulakum min khilāfiw walaʾuṣallibannakum ajmaʿīn

ar: قَالُوا۟ لَا ضَيْرَ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا مُنقَلِبُونَ
en: (50) They said, "No harm. Indeed, to our Lord we will return.
tr: Qālū lā ḍayr, innā ilā rabbinā munqalibūn

ar: إِنَّا نَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لَنَا رَبُّنَا خَطَٰيَٰنَآ أَن كُنَّآ أَوَّلَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
en: (51) Indeed, we aspire that our Lord will forgive us our sins because we were the first of the believers."
tr: Innā naṭmaʿu ay yaghfira lanā rabbunā khaṭāyānā an kunnā awwalal-muʾminīn

ar: وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِىٓ إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
en: (52) And We inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants; indeed, you will be pursued."
tr: Waʾawḥaynā ilā mūsā an asri biʿibādī innakum muttabaʿūn

en: (53) Then Pharaoh sent among the cities gatherers[1050]
enNotes: [1050]- Recruiters of an army to prevent the emigration of the Children of Israel.

en: (54) [And said], "Indeed, those are but a small band,
(55) And indeed, they are enraging us,
(56) And indeed, we are a cautious society..."
(57) So We removed them from gardens and springs
(58) And treasures and honorable station[1051] -
enNotes: [1051]- Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) caused them to abandon their wealth and property in pursuit of the Israelites.

en: (59) Thus. And We caused to inherit it the Children of Israel.
(60) So they pursued them at sunrise.

ar: فَلَمَّا تَرَٰٓءَا ٱلْجَمْعَانِ قَالَ أَصْحَٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّا لَمُدْرَكُونَ
en: (61) And when the two companies saw one another, the companions of Moses said, "Indeed, we are to be overtaken!"
tr: Falammā tarāʾal-jamʿāni qāla aṣḥābu mūsā innā lamudrakūn

ar: قَالَ كَلَّآ إِنَّ مَعِىَ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ
en: (62) [Moses] said, "No! Indeed, with me is my Lord; He will guide me."
tr: Qāla kallā, inna maʿiya rabbī sayahdīn

ar: فَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱضْرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلْبَحْرَ فَٱنفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرْقٍ كَٱلطَّوْدِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
en: (63) Then We inspired to Moses, "Strike with your staff the sea," and it parted, and each portion was like a great towering mountain.
tr: Faʾawḥaynā ilā mūsā aniḍrib biʿaṣākal-baḥr, fanfalaqa fakāna kullu firqin kaṭ-ṭawdil-ʿaẓīm

en: (64) And We advanced thereto the others [i.e., the pursuers].
(65) And We saved Moses and those with him, all together.
(66) Then We drowned the others.

ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
en: (67) Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
tr: Inna fī dhālika laʾāyah, wamā kāna aktharuhum muʾminīn

en: (68) And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
(69) And recite to them the news of Abraham,

ar: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ
en: (70) When he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship?"
tr: Idh qāla liʾabīhi waqawmihī mā taʿbudūn

ar: قَالُوا۟ نَعْبُدُ أَصْنَامًا فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عَٰكِفِينَ
en: (71) They said, "We worship idols and remain to them devoted."
tr: Qālū naʿbudu aṣnāman fanaẓallu lahā ʿākifīn

en: (72) He said, "Do they hear you when you supplicate?
(73) Or do they benefit you, or do they harm?"

ar: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا كَذَٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ
en: (74) They said, "But we found our fathers doing thus."
tr: Qālū bal wajadnā ābāʾanā kadhālika yafʿalūn

en: (75) He said, "Then do you see what you have been worshipping,
(76) You and your ancient forefathers?

ar: فَإِنَّهُمْ عَدُوٌّ لِّىٓ إِلَّا رَبَّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
en: (77) Indeed, they are enemies to me, except the Lord of the worlds,[1052]
enNotes: [1052]- The people worshipped idols in addition to Allāh.

en: (78) Who created me, and He [it is who] guides me.
(79) And it is He who feeds me and gives me drink.
(80) And when I am ill, it is He who cures me
(81) And who will cause me to die and then bring me to life

ar: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لِى خَطِيٓـَٔتِى يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
en: (82) And who I aspire that He will forgive me my sin on the Day of Recompense."
tr: Wal-ladhī aṭmaʿu ay yaghfira lī khaṭīʾatī yawmad-dīn

ar: رَبِّ هَبْ لِى حُكْمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِى بِٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
en: (83) [And he said], "My Lord, grant me authority and join me with the righteous.
tr: Rabbi hab lī ḥukmaw waʾalḥiqnī biṣ-ṣāliḥīn

ar: وَٱجْعَل لِّى لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
en: (84) And grant me a mention [i.e., reputation] of honor among later generations.
(85) And place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Pleasure.

ar: وَٱغْفِرْ لِأَبِىٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
en: (86) And forgive my father. Indeed, he has been of those astray.
(87) And do not disgrace me on the Day they are [all] resurrected -

ar: يَوْمَ لَا يَنفَعُ مَالٌ وَلَا بَنُونَ
en: (88) The Day when there will not benefit [anyone] wealth or children
tr: Yawma lā yanfaʿu māluw walā banūn

ar: إِلَّا مَنْ أَتَى ٱللَّهَ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ
en: (89) But only one who comes to Allāh with a sound heart."
(90) And Paradise will be brought near [that Day] to the righteous.
(91) And Hellfire will be brought forth for the deviators,

ar: وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ
en: (92) And it will be said to them, "Where are those you used to worship
tr: Waqīla lahum ayna mā kuntum taʿbudūn

ar: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ هَلْ يَنصُرُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَنتَصِرُونَ
en: (93) Other than Allāh? Can they help you or help themselves?"
tr: Min dūnillāh, hal yanṣurūnakum aw yantaṣirūn

en: (94) So they will be overturned into it [i.e., Hellfire], they and the deviators
(95) And the soldiers of Iblees, all together.
(96) They will say while they dispute therein,

ar: تَٱللَّهِ إِن كُنَّا لَفِى ضَلَٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
en: (97) "By Allāh, we were indeed in manifest error
tr: Tallāhi in kunnā lafī ḍalālim mubīn

en: (98) When we equated you with the Lord of the worlds.
(99) And no one misguided us except the criminals.
(100) So now we have no intercessors
(101) And not a devoted friend.

ar: فَلَوْ أَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةً فَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
en: (102) Then if we only had a return [to the world] and could be of the believers..."[1053]
enNotes: [1053]- The conclusion of this verse is estimated as "...we would do this or that."
tr: Falaw anna lanā karratan fanakūna minal-muʾminīn

ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
en: (103) Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
tr: Inna fī dhālika laʾāyah, wamā kāna aktharuhum muʾminīn

en: (104) And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
(105) The people of Noah denied the messengers[1054]
enNotes: [1054]- See footnote to 25:37.

ar: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ نُوحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
en: (106) When their brother Noah said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?
tr: Idh qāla lahum akhūhum nūḥun alā tattaqūn

en: (107) Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
(108) So fear Allāh and obey me.

ar: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
en: (109) And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
tr: Wamā asʾalukum ʿalayhi min ajr, in ajriya illā ʿalā rabbil-ʿālamīn

en: (110) So fear Allāh and obey me."
(111) They said, "Should we believe you while you are followed by the lowest [class of people]?"

ar: قَالَ وَمَا عِلْمِى بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
en: (112) He said, "And what is my knowledge of what they used to do?
tr: Qāla wamā ʿilmī bimā kānū yaʿmalūn

ar: إِنْ حِسَابُهُمْ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّى لَوْ تَشْعُرُونَ
en: (113) Their account is only upon my Lord, if you [could] perceive.
tr: In ḥisābuhum illā ʿalā rabbī law tashʿurūn

en: (114) And I am not one to drive away the believers.
(115) I am only a clear warner."

ar: قَالُوا۟ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَٰنُوحُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمَرْجُومِينَ
en: (116) They said, "If you do not desist, O Noah, you will surely be of those who are stoned."
tr: Qālū laʾil lam tantahi yānūḥu latakūnanna minal-marjūmīn

en: (117) He said, "My Lord, indeed my people have denied me.

ar: فَٱفْتَحْ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَهُمْ فَتْحًا وَنَجِّنِى وَمَن مَّعِىَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
en: (118) Then judge between me and them with decisive judgement and save me and those with me of the believers."
tr: Faftaḥ baynī wabaynahum fatḥaw wanajjinī wamam maʿiya minal-muʾminīn

ar: فَأَنجَيْنَٰهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ
en: (119) So We saved him and those with him in the laden ship.
(120) Then We drowned thereafter the remaining ones.

ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
en: (121) Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
tr: Inna fī dhālika laʾāyah, wamā kāna aktharuhum muʾminīn

en: (122) And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
(123) ʿAad denied the messengers

ar: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ هُودٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
en: (124) When their brother Hūd said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?
tr: Idh qāla lahum akhūhum hūdun alā tattaqūn

en: (125) Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
(126) So fear Allāh and obey me.

ar: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
en: (127) And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
tr: Wamā asʾalukum ʿalayhi min ajr, in ajriya illā ʿalā rabbil-ʿālamīn

en: (128) Do you construct on every elevation a sign,[1055] amusing yourselves,
enNotes: [1055]- i.e., a symbol or indication of their wealth and power. They used to build lofty structures along the road to be seen by all who passed by.

en: (129) And take for yourselves constructions [i.e., palaces and fortresses] that you might abide eternally?
(130) And when you strike, you strike as tyrants.
(131) So fear Allāh and obey me.
(132) And fear He who provided you with that which you know,
(133) Provided you with grazing livestock and children
(134) And gardens and springs.

ar: إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
en: (135) Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a terrible day."
tr: Innī akhāfu ʿalaykum ʿadhāba yawmin ʿaẓīm

ar: قَالُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْنَآ أَوَعَظْتَ أَمْ لَمْ تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْوَٰعِظِينَ
en: (136) They said, "It is all the same to us whether you advise or are not of the advisors.
tr: Qālū sawāʾun ʿalaynā awaʿaẓta am lam takum minal-wāʿiẓīn

en: (137) This is not but the custom of the former peoples,
(138) And we are not to be punished."

ar: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَهْلَكْنَٰهُمْ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
en: (139) And they denied him, so We destroyed them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
tr: Fakadhdhabūhu faʾahlaknāhum, inna fī dhālika laʾāyah, wamā kāna aktharuhum muʾminīn

en: (140) And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
(141) Thamūd denied the messengers

ar: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ صَٰلِحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
en: (142) When their brother Ṣāliḥ said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?
tr: Idh qāla lahum akhūhum ṣāliḥun alā tattaqūn

en: (143) Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
(144) So fear Allāh and obey me.

ar: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
en: (145) And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
tr: Wamā asʾalukum ʿalayhi min ajr, in ajriya illā ʿalā rabbil-ʿālamīn

en: (146) Will you be left in what is here, secure [from death],
(147) Within gardens and springs
(148) And fields of crops and palm trees with softened fruit?
(149) And you carve out of the mountains, homes, with skill.
(150) So fear Allāh and obey me.
(151) And do not obey the order of the transgressors,

ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُونَ
en: (152) Who cause corruption in the land and do not amend."
(153) They said, "You are only of those affected by magic.

ar: مَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا فَأْتِ بِـَٔايَةٍ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
en: (154) You are but a man like ourselves, so bring a sign, if you should be of the truthful."
tr: Mā anta illā basharum mithlunā faʾti biʾāyatin in kunta minaṣ-ṣādiqīn

ar: قَالَ هَٰذِهِۦ نَاقَةٌ لَّهَا شِرْبٌ وَلَكُمْ شِرْبُ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
en: (155) He said, "This is a she-camel.[1056] For her is a [time of] drink, and for you is a [time of] drink, [each] on a known day.
enNotes: [1056]- Miraculously sent to them as a sign by Allāh.
tr: Qāla hādhihī nāqatul lahā shirbuw walakum shirbu yawmim maʿlūm

ar: وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوٓءٍ فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
en: (156) And do not touch her with harm, lest you be seized by the punishment of a terrible day."
tr: Walā tamassūhā bisūʾin fayaʾkhudhakum ʿadhābu yawmin ʿaẓīm

en: (157) But they hamstrung her and so became regretful.

ar: فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
en: (158) And the punishment seized them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
tr: Faʾakhadhahumul-ʿadhāb, inna fī dhālika laʾāyah, wamā kāna aktharuhum muʾminīn

en: (159) And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
(160) The people of Lot denied the messengers

ar: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ لُوطٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
en: (161) When their brother Lot said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?
tr: Idh qāla lahum akhūhum lūṭun alā tattaqūn

en: (162) Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
(163) So fear Allāh and obey me.

ar: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
en: (164) And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
tr: Wamā asʾalukum ʿalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illā ʿalā rabbil-ʿālamīn

en: (165) Do you approach males among the worlds[1057]
enNotes: [1057]- i.e., Are there, out of all Allāh's creatures, any besides you who commit this unnatural act?

ar: وَتَذَرُونَ مَا خَلَقَ لَكُمْ رَبُّكُم مِّنْ أَزْوَٰجِكُم بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌ عَادُونَ
en: (166) And leave what your Lord has created for you as mates? But you are a people transgressing."
tr: Watadharūna mā khalaqa lakum rabbukum min azwājikum, bal antum qawmun ʿādūn

ar: قَالُوا۟ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَٰلُوطُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمُخْرَجِينَ
en: (167) They said, "If you do not desist, O Lot, you will surely be of those evicted."
tr: Qālū laʾil lam tantahi yālūṭu latakūnanna minal-mukhrajīn

en: (168) He said, "Indeed, I am, toward your deed, of those who detest [it].
(169) My Lord, save me and my family from [the consequence of] what they do."
(170) So We saved him and his family, all,
(171) Except an old woman[1058] among those who remained behind.
enNotes: [1058]- Lot's wife, who had collaborated with the evildoers.

en: (172) Then We destroyed the others.

ar: وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّطَرًا فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
en: (173) And We rained upon them a rain [of stones], and evil was the rain of those who were warned.

ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
en: (174) Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
tr: Inna fī dhālika laʾāyah, wamā kāna aktharuhum muʾminīn

en: (175) And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
(176) The companions of the thicket [i.e., the people of Madyan] denied the messengers

ar: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ شُعَيْبٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
en: (177) When Shuʿayb said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?
tr: Idh qāla lahum shuʿaybun alā tattaqūn

en: (178) Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
(179) So fear Allāh and obey me.

ar: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
en: (180) And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
tr: Wamā asʾalukum ʿalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illā ʿalā rabbil-ʿālamīn

ar: أَوْفُوا۟ ٱلْكَيْلَ وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْمُخْسِرِينَ
en: (181) Give full measure and do not be of those who cause loss.
(182) And weigh with an even [i.e., honest] balance.

ar: وَلَا تَبْخَسُوا۟ ٱلنَّاسَ أَشْيَآءَهُمْ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ
en: (183) And do not deprive people of their due and do not commit abuse on earth, spreading corruption.
tr: Walā tabkhasun-nāsa ashyāʾahum walā taʿthaw fil-arḍi mufsidīn

en: (184) And fear He who created you and the former creation."[1059]
enNotes: [1059]- i.e., previous generations.

en: (185) They said, "You are only of those affected by magic.

ar: وَمَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا وَإِن نَّظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْكَٰذِبِينَ
en: (186) You are but a man like ourselves, and indeed, we think you are among the liars.
tr: Wamā anta illā basharum mithlunā waʾin naẓunnuka laminal-kādhibīn

ar: فَأَسْقِطْ عَلَيْنَا كِسَفًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
en: (187) So cause to fall upon us fragments of the sky, if you should be of the truthful."
tr: Faʾasqiṭ ʿalaynā kisafam minas-samāʾi in kunta minaṣ-ṣādiqīn

en: (188) He said, "My Lord is most knowing of what you do."

ar: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمِ ٱلظُّلَّةِ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
en: (189) And they denied him, so the punishment of the day of the black cloud seized them. Indeed, it was the punishment of a terrible day.
tr: Fakadhdhabūhu faʾakhadhahum ʿadhābu yawmiẓ-ẓullah, innahū kāna ʿadhāba yawmin ʿaẓīm

ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
en: (190) Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
tr: Inna fī dhālika laʾāyah, wamā kāna aktharuhum muʾminīn

en: (191) And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
(192) And indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is the revelation of the Lord of the worlds.
(193) The Trustworthy Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] has brought it down
(194) Upon your heart, [O Muḥammad] - that you may be of the warners
(195) In a clear Arabic language.
(196) And indeed, it is [mentioned] in the scriptures of former peoples.

ar: أَوَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُمْ ءَايَةً أَن يَعْلَمَهُۥ عُلَمَٰٓؤُا۟ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
en: (197) And has it not been a sign to them that it is recognized by the scholars of the Children of Israel?
tr: Awalam yakul lahum āyatan ay yaʿlamahū ʿulamāʾu banī isrāʾīl

en: (198) And even if We had revealed it to one among the foreigners[1060]
enNotes: [1060]- i.e., the non-Arabs or those who are not fluent in the Arabic language.

ar: فَقَرَأَهُۥ عَلَيْهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ مُؤْمِنِينَ
en: (199) And he had recited it to them [perfectly],[1061] they would [still] not have been believers in it.
enNotes: [1061]- As a miracle from Allāh.
tr: Faqaraʾahū ʿalayhim mā kānū bihī muʾminīn

en: (200) Thus have We inserted it [i.e., disbelief] into the hearts of the criminals.

ar: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
en: (201) They will not believe in it until they see the painful punishment.
(202) And it will come to them suddenly while they perceive [it] not.
(203) And they will say, "May we be reprieved?"
(204) So for Our punishment are they impatient?
(205) Then have you considered if We gave them enjoyment for years
(206) And then there came to them that which they were promised?

ar: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يُمَتَّعُونَ
en: (207) They would not be availed by the enjoyment with which they were provided.
tr: Mā aghnā ʿanhum mā kānū yumattaʿūn

ar: وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا لَهَا مُنذِرُونَ
en: (208) And We did not destroy any city except that it had warners
tr: Wamā ahlaknā min qaryatin illā lahā mundhirūn

en: (209) As a reminder; and never have We been unjust.
(210) And the devils have not brought it [i.e., the revelation] down.[1062]
enNotes: [1062]- As was asserted by the disbelievers. Rather, it was brought by Gabriel, the Trustworthy Spirit.

en: (211) It is not allowable for them, nor would they be able.
(212) Indeed they, from [its] hearing, are removed.[1063]
enNotes: [1063]- As mentioned in 72:9.

ar: فَلَا تَدْعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُعَذَّبِينَ
en: (213) So do not invoke[1064] with Allāh another deity and [thus] be among the punished.
enNotes: [1064]- Or "worship."
tr: Falā tadʿu maʿallāhi ilāhan ākhara fatakūna minal-muʿadhdhabīn

en: (214) And warn, [O Muḥammad], your closest kindred.

ar: وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
en: (215) And lower your wing [i.e., show kindness] to those who follow you of the believers.

ar: فَإِنْ عَصَوْكَ فَقُلْ إِنِّى بَرِىٓءٌ مِّمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
en: (216) And if they disobey you, then say, "Indeed, I am disassociated from what you are doing."
tr: Faʾin ʿaṣawka faqul innī barīʾum mimmā taʿmalūn

en: (217) And rely upon the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,
(218) Who sees you when you arise[1065]
enNotes: [1065]- From your bed at night for prayer while you are alone.

en: (219) And your movement among those who prostrate.[1066]
enNotes: [1066]- i.e., among those who pray with you in congregation.

en: (220) Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.

ar: هَلْ أُنَبِّئُكُمْ عَلَىٰ مَن تَنَزَّلُ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينُ
en: (221) Shall I inform you upon whom the devils descend?
(222) They descend upon every sinful liar.
(223) They pass on what is heard,[1067] and most of them are liars.
enNotes: [1067]- This was before they were prevented, as described in 72:8-9.

en: (224) And the poets - [only] the deviators follow them.

ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّهُمْ فِى كُلِّ وَادٍ يَهِيمُونَ
en: (225) Do you not see that in every valley they roam[1068]
enNotes: [1068]- Speaking lies indiscriminately and praising and disparaging others according to whim.
tr: Alam tara annahum fī kulli wādiy yahīmūn

en: (226) And that they say what they do not do? -

ar: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَذَكَرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرًا وَٱنتَصَرُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا ظُلِمُوا۟ وَسَيَعْلَمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ أَىَّ مُنقَلَبٍ يَنقَلِبُونَ
en: (227) Except those [poets] who believe and do righteous deeds and remember Allāh often and defend [the Muslims][1069] after they were wronged. And those who have wronged are going to know to what [kind of] return they will be returned.
enNotes: [1069]- By replying through poetry to the attacks of hostile poets.
tr: Illal-ladhīna āmanū waʿamiluṣ-ṣāliḥāti wadhakarullāha kathīraw wantaṣarū mim baʿdi mā ẓulimū, wasayaʿlamul-ladhīna ẓalamū ayya munqalabiy yanqalibūn
